evidence_question: What sirens existed, were active, disabled, credited, or out of service during the June 2026 exercise window?
minimum_artifacts: current inventory/status; county-specific status; activation/test/failure logs

evidence_question: Was a siren-decommissioning or ANS transition plan approved by PEMA/FEMA, and when was it effective?
minimum_artifacts: approval/status letter; implementation date; interim-state memo; public-notice artifact

evidence_question: Were sirens, IPAWS/WEA/ENS, EAS, route alerting, or hybrid channels credited in the evaluated ANS demonstration?
minimum_artifacts: extent-of-play; objective matrix; evaluator notes; ANS demo description

evidence_question: What alert channels actually activated, what messages were sent, and what delivery/failure metrics exist?
minimum_artifacts: IPAWS/WEA/ENS logs; message content; polygons/scope; delivery/failure/bounce metrics; timestamps

evidence_question: Did EAS stations receive, air, repeat, and preserve the message in the expected window?
minimum_artifacts: ENDEC/broadcast logs; station confirmations; audio/text; timing records

evidence_question: If electronic/siren channels failed or were degraded, was backup route alerting available and exercised?
minimum_artifacts: route-alerting plan; staffing; route logs; exception/failure notes; evaluator disposition

evidence_question: Were AFN and language/accessibility populations covered by registration, notification, transport, and public communication paths?
minimum_artifacts: anonymized AFN counts; language access materials; transport coordination; accessibility notes; evaluator disposition

evidence_question: For any ANS failure/partial/degraded performance, was CAP/retest completed and accepted?
minimum_artifacts: CAP owner; due date; retest logs; acceptance criteria; unresolved-state note

evidence_question: If artifacts arrive, credit only bounded channel/objective claims, never whole-readiness conclusions.
minimum_artifacts: intake ledger; proofcut mapping; reviewer limitation note
